description: highly detailed HD pixel art with painterly shading and layered depth, a cinematic wide establishing shot for a trucking tycoon game: Newark and the Manhattan skyline across the river with the Empire State Building, One World Trade Center and the Statue of Liberty, its real skyline rising in the middle distance with every landmark clearly recognisable, seen from above a busy interstate in the foreground where American long-nose conventional semi tractors with long hoods, chrome grilles and sleeper cabs pull white trailers, never a flat-faced European cab-over truck, a blank green overhead highway sign, the city's own surroundings and water or hills beyond, golden hour with long warm shadows and lit windows, a saturated orange and purple sky, no text, lettering, words, labels or logos anywhere
